S1.loss: Teacher forcing masked cross entropy; average over valid service decisions within each route, then mean over4 instances. Empty valid route loss0, no STOP label or replacement.
S1.batch_sampling: With replacement from fixed256 teachers using phase-specific PCG64 stream keyed by(optimizer_seed,S1_data); record each index.
S1.shared_teacher_dataset: Build256Detour16_endpoint native outputs plus one extra commonH per route ONCE, maximum512 terminal evaluations, shared all3 optimizer seeds.

S1.generation_pipeline: For each declared spec, generate original frozen make_complex_scene then frozen resample_tasks, build proxy F and make_allow A, verify canonical geometry/source and full-target connected effective service, extract unchanged-parent task window, nativeDetour16, commonH, endpoint export and independent proxy validation; persist all inputs/full native and H plans/labels/metrics/resource failures. S2.core: genuine policy-gradient optimization on large complex parent scenes
S2.episodes: 50% full10x10 tasks,50% local windows balanced4x3/6x6/8x8, all embedded in original10x10 geometry/navigation
S2.task_and_constraints: Sample declared parent/task bank only, A_condition=(parent_index+task_draw_index)%3 using frozen make_allow; unchanged proxy F and base footprint. Whole-parent task density/obstacles/F&A remain visible.
S2.windows_and_endpoints: Full episodes closed depot; local size cyclic4x3/6x6/8x8, x0/y0 uniformly drawn among valid table-grid origins from sampling RNG. Alternate closed depot and open first/last depot-connected global candidates by local episode index.
S2.schedule: For each seed, zero-based u=0..511 and slot=0..3 use its own named S2_data PCG64 stream keyed by this protocol SHA and optimizer_seed. Draw parent and task_draw uniformly with replacement. Even u: full10x10 closed; odd u: local_index=((u-1)//2)*4+slot, cyclic size, uniformly valid origin, alternating closed/open. Same instance gets one natural trajectory plus forced low/high legal original-ID starts. Distinct starts only when >=2 legal first actions; sole-action exception is mandatory.
S2.starts: Primary includes its sampled first-action logprob. Auxiliary low/high roles force the lowest/highest currently legal original-ID candidate and exclude that forced-first logprob. With unique_first=1, both auxiliary roles force that same action and independently sample suffixes with unchanged .25/.25 weights. All rows finish same target/endpoints; record unique_first, do not deduplicate or assume TSP symmetry.
S2.loss: For each trajectory use detached leave-one-out mean return of the other2 as baseline. Negative advantage*logprob: primary weight1, each forced auxiliary weight.25, divide total by1.5. S0 forced-only probe checks plumbing, not this future optimizer.
S2.objective: REINFORCE on negative complete JH with exact masks and explicit entry/exit; no teacher action-regression substitute
S2.optimizer: Adam1e-4,clip1,512 fixed updates,batch4instances,3 optimizer seeds11622026..28; save fixed end, no S3 selection
S2.controls: frozen_SL same S1 weight; continuedSL fresh Adam512 on same frozen S1 teacher pool, same CE/batch4, independent phase sampling. This compares training pipelines, not equal-FLOPs or pure algorithm causality.
S2.development: 18 declared local cases on3 separate parent layouts, checked at updates256 and512 for feasibility/resources only; no best-checkpoint selection and no S3 reads
S2.missing_reward: Failures charged; do not silently discard/reward-zero infeasible routes; stop incomplete. No new seed/epoch rescue.
S2.boundary: Training and controls remain supervised+RL distinction; final contribution requires positive independent RL increment, not merely smaller degradation.
S2.parent_modes: Exactly96 mixed/blocked training geometry keys (48each) already checked. The768 declared target-task draws remain ungenerated and not globally certified; each accessed full-target F&A/navigation instance must pass before use, otherwise stop without replacement.
S2.forward_backward_execution: Macro batch4, fixed weights throughout batch; accumulate gradient of instance_loss/4 separately, clip once after4, optimizer.step once. This matches batch-mean objective; before formal use require synthetic value/gradient equivalence regression. Separate prefix caches across3 trajectories; rebuild encodings after any weight update.
S2.mixed_objective: Preserve v2 weighted mixture [E_primary R+.25E_forcedlow R+.25E_forcedhigh R]/1.5 with R=-JH. Primary includes first logprob; forced auxiliary starts do not. Each row baseline detached mean of other2 independent returns.

boundaries.empty_instance: Legal direct entry->exit terminal, zero logprob/loss contribution, still record cost; never replace sample.
boundaries.all_empty_macro_batch: Inconclusive stop before optimizer; do not resample to force512steps.
boundaries.one_legal_first: Both auxiliary roles use the only legal first node, independent suffix generators; retain .25/.25 weights and record unique_first=1, no silent dedup reweight.
boundaries.zero_advantage_nonempty: Keep registered update schedule, record zero-signal batch, no extra entropy/teacher/round; optimizer step with computed zero grads is recorded.
boundaries.invalid_or_nonfinite: Pre-debit work, preserve failure, stop inconclusive; no reward-zero pseudo-success or replacement.

S2.memory_execution: Use fixed instance gradient accumulation to avoid holding12full-episode graphs simultaneously. Bounded navigation cache max2parent maps; task-conditioned neural cache per episode and bound to task/F/A/D/weights. Before first optimizer validate actual batch4-equivalent memory and gradients; no automatic batch/scale/budget change.

S3.independent_RL_gate: ALL valid; vs frozen SL and continued-SL mean paired gain>=.5% with parent-cluster bootstrap95 lower>0, each size reported; three optimizer seeds direction consistent; no use of action Top1 as final success
S3.deployment_gate: vs Detour16 mean relative degradation one-sided95upper<=.5%; complete median time ratio<=.7 and p95<=1 in both cache modes; not dominated byFixed3; report seen/unseen and each size separately
S3.bootstrap: 20000 physical-parent-cluster resamples, PCG64 seed11632026, same declared parent resample indices used across matched methods/controls within each cell. Seen6 and unseen12 parents separate; not108 independent environments; intervals not simultaneous familywise coverage.
S3.no_blending: Report raw/H gains separately, no teacher search at inference, no returned-home/exit connection cost omission
S3.parent_modes: Declared6 seen/12 unseen geometries, actual canonical identities already independently verified in saved geometry gate. S3 tasks/routes/costs remain sealed; layout evidence is not task feasibility.
S3.primary_decision: Overall independent-RL claim requires all6(group x size) quality cells; overall deployment claim requires all12(group x size x cache) strata. Both classes AND only for a combined quality-and-deployment claim; no pooled rescue. Partial per-cell evidence may be reported with explicit limited scope, not overall pass.
S3.quality_aggregation: Within each group,size,method,seed: average two endpoint-child J values for each physical parent. For pooled estimate then average the three matched optimizer-seed parent values; compute parent-relative gain from these method means, then equally average parent gains. FrozenSL/continuedSL are matched to their own seed lineage. Bootstrap true physical parent clusters only.
S3.RL_gate_per_cell: For BOTH frozenSL and continuedSL: all cases valid; mean paired parent-relative gain >=0.5%; percentile two-sided95 bootstrap lower (2.5th percentile)>0; each of3 optimizer-seed point gains strictly positive. All6 group-size cells required for overall independent-RL claim.
S3.deployment_gate_per_stratum: For each group,size,cache: all cases valid; parent-aggregated RLplusH degradation versus Detour16 one-sided95 percentile upper (95th percentile)<=0.5%; pooled complete-request median time ratio<=0.7 and p95 ratio<=1; RLplusH not Pareto dominated by Fixed3 on meanJ/median/p95 (all <= and at least one strict is domination). All12 strata required for overall deployment claim.
S3.timing_aggregation: Within each group,size,cache, pool all parent x endpoint x seed x3repeat request timings for descriptive median/p95. Quality uses parent units, not request count. Endpoint-specific tables always reported; no causal endpoint/position comparison.
S3.statistical_scope: One preregistered data-bank screen with3optimization repeats, not3independent datasets. CIs not advertised as simultaneous acrossallcells. No claim of pure-gradient/equal-FLOPs causality becauseRL states on-policy andSL teacher pool fixed.
